text:
My mouth with a mischievous kiss

sought your traitorous swallows,

and I felt your captive eyelashes

beating in the curves of my kiss.


Matter freed me of its weight...

a blaze of springs passed through me

and the soul, anesthetized with chimeras,

knew the fruition of rapture.


It was a moment of peace so exquisite

that I sipped the light of infinity

and was assailed by the desire to weep.


Do you remember that the afternoon was dying

and while you whispered: "Mine! Mine!"

like a child I began to sob?...

translation.title: Do You Remember?
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the sonnet's move from erotic lightness into childlike sobbing.
